downloadable_stories.title: The Clockmaker's Secret
downloadable_stories.description: An old clockmaker in Vienna discovers a hidden room inside his own shop after repairing a mysterious pocket watch left by a stranger.

downloadable_stories.title: The Last Train
downloadable_stories.description: A young woman quits her job and boards the last midnight train to a city she has never visited, carrying nothing but a bag and a need to start over.

downloadable_stories.title: Sunday Soup
downloadable_stories.description: Every Sunday, Oscar makes soup alone in his small kitchen — the same soup, the same way his wife taught him. One Sunday, his new neighbor knocks to borrow salt. She stays for the whole afternoon.
